description: Implementation of the TransactionService interface, managing payment transactions including creation, listing, retrieval of capturable and refundable transactions, and JSON processing related to Transaction objects.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing payment transaction management, including creation, listing, and retrieval of transactions based on various criteria.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing transaction details into JSON and saving it.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a given order, deserializing transaction details from JSON.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Fetches a transaction suitable for capture (authorization), converting JSON details into a Map.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Determines the most appropriate transaction for a refund, considering authorization, capture, and refund types, and deserializes details.
